name: EH3D-NODE-PNP-FEEDER
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); ESP-IDF firmware for the ESP32-S3 (not written yet)
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host -C Debug
notes: Functional v0.0.4: the node of the tape feeders of a pick-and-place machine. It advances the tape of each feeder by a pitch of 2, 4, 8, 12 or 16 mm over RS-485, CAN or I2C (a setting) with its own checked frame, counts the parts, watches the pocket, the tension and the cover film, holds a fault when the tape jams and stops by itself when it loses the node or the server. The rules are in the host-tested core and are tried against a simulator of the chain; the ESP-IDF firmware is not written, and nothing has been connected to a motor, a tape sensor or a bus.
